description: For the graph view only, not for a model: the behold-graph/1 document of a graph call, taking the same arguments, so the view can draw it. The model is never offered this tool, and its answer never enters the conversation.

around.description: Comma-separated card or box ids to cut around (a root such as a Terraform root, or a card id from the roots table), with what is within depth hops of them.

changed.description: A revision range, <base>..<head> or <base>...<head> (from the merge base): cut to what changed between the two commits and the cards within depth hops.

depth.description: Hops from the cards around names, or from what changed (default 1).

dir.description: A folder inside the project to read, relative to it (default: the project folder).

direction.description: With around: up follows what the cards depend on, down what depends on them (default both).

name: graph_document
